pages.text: The Quantum Quarry is a work-in-progress block available in Creative. It has an assembly check and a prototype menu. For a working mining machine, build the $(l:extrautilitiesrebirth:mining/ender_quarry)Ender Quarry$(/l).

pages.title: Quantum Quarry Actuator
pages.text: The Quantum Quarry Actuator is the companion Creative block. The assembly check expects an actuator against each of the six faces. This assembly has no production recipe or mining output.
